$comment: What Annulon claims, where it was demonstrated, and what it cannot do. A capability is SUPPORTED only on a reference profile where it was physically demonstrated with an evidence artifact (ADR-055). Machine-readable so tools/verify_all.py can refuse a claim with no evidence behind it.

profiles.REF-DEV: Docker Desktop Linux VM, linuxkit kernel, aarch64, container. Development and integration evidence only.
profiles.REF-HOST: Ubuntu LTS x86_64 on EC2 t3a.large, pinned AMI, SSM only, no inbound ports. The reference profile.

capabilities.evidence: netlink proc connector experiments; 500/500 short-lived execs with a passing negative control
limitations: requires CONFIG_CONNECTOR; absent on REF-DEV, where the sensor refuses to start rather than degrading
TCP connect semantics only; UDP is not covered
post-start activity only; not a connection inventory
observes host-namespace pids; container attribution NOT_RUN
flow identity is not namespace-qualified on this tier
about half of short-lived connections cannot be bound to a workload
would capture process-instance identity in-kernel and remove the attribution race at source; not implemented
the probe is loopback; it proves the observation path, not external connectivity
a deterministic allowlist only; no behavioural or statistical detection
IPv4 only; an IPv4-scoped rule does not restrict IPv6 (KF-38)
scopes by uid, so a shared service account means collateral containment
does not survive a reboot, by design (ADR-052)

capabilities.evidence: OVS datapath and OpenFlow experiments; host crossover with a passing negative control
limitations: detection only; the SDN pack has no enforcement path and its findings offer no containment response
no flow-rule enforcement path exists; SDN findings deliberately do not offer TEMPORARY_CONTAINMENT
no multi-host enrolment, identity or aggregation exists. The single-host agent is the whole product today.
AWS is used to host the reference lab. No cloud audit-log ingestion or cloud-side detection exists.
the identity model reserves AI_TASK, AI_MODEL and AI_TOOL entity kinds; no AI integration exists, and none may bypass the deterministic broker when it does
